mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_message_action (message_id, action_type, actor_account_id, actor_type, note, created_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{actionType}, #{actorAccountId}, #{actorType}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, action_type, actor_account_id, actor_type, note, created_at FROM sr_message_action WHERE message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
